title: The Sequence That Reduced Risk
short_teaser: Some plans arrange steps so the least expensive learning happens first.
story: Some plans arrange steps so the least expensive learning happens first. Order can matter as much as content. Strategy means choosing what matters most and placing effort where it can create the greatest useful change. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
